title: 第十七章 无常塔二第十八章 无常塔三
content_zh:
柳辰有些希翼的看向通往第三层的入口，也不怪柳辰这副表情，实在是前面两层实在是太让人失望了。
柳辰本来进塔之前还有点忐忑，担心遇到新的危险。
结果却大大出乎他的意料，不仅进入塔内的大门没有任何禁制，很轻松就打开了。
前两层更是普通的有些过了，第一层除了几尊跟塔身同样材质的石像外什么都没有。
第二层则是只有一些普通的桌椅茶具，只不过制作的木料是凡俗难得一见的珍贵品种。
要不是在二层的角落发现两具傀儡，柳辰都要以为这是哪个世俗贵族的待客厅，而不是强大修士的居所。
这两具傀儡最后被沐雨柔收入了自己的空间装备之中。
用她的话说，这是两具生活辅助型傀儡，负责修士平时生活中的一些琐事，比如打扫卫生等。
这种傀儡一般不具备攻击能力，但是都是人类形态的，毕竟修士不同于武者，在世俗有庞大的家族，有大量的侍女奴仆驱使。
修士大部分都是一些苦修士，大多是一个人居住，这时就需要这类型的傀儡帮助解决生活中的一些琐事。
这两具傀儡都是女性的形态，想来沐雨柔是打算拿回去自己用的。
不过沐雨柔承诺后面如果遇到适合他的战斗型傀儡可以给他一个，并帮他炼制一枚能让他驱使的玉牌。
因为武者的灵魂比较弱，在突破到正式武者之前是不具备神识的。
所以柳辰要想驱使傀儡就需要特殊的法器进行辅助才行。
这也是柳辰对后面比较期待的原因，如果他能得到一具强大的傀儡，那对他的实力将会有巨大的提升。
而且柳辰得到的几率也很大，因为沐雨柔说过无常老人除了炼器之外最擅长的就是傀儡术。
“碰，碰”
两人刚刚进入三层走在前面的沐雨柔就受到两道攻击。
还好沐雨柔反应够快及时祭出一面盾牌挡下了两道攻击。
“这是两具一级的战斗傀儡，不解决它们没法继续前进，你先退回二层，等我解决了它们你再上来。”

挡下攻击的沐雨柔扭头对柳辰说道。
柳辰闻言不敢停留，急忙顺着楼梯退了回去。
但是在离开前他还是向三层的方向看了一眼。
这一眼柳辰就直接震惊了，只见三层的空间比柳辰想象中要大的多。
柳辰看到有一条蛇跟一只剑齿虎守在那里，全身由不知名金属构成，显然不是真实的生物体。
此时这两具傀儡嘴中有光芒闪烁，显然刚刚的攻击就是这么发出的。
应该就是沐雨柔所说的两具一级傀儡，这两具傀儡都有数米大小，给柳辰强大的压迫感。
这还不是最让柳辰震惊的，最让他震惊的是两具傀儡的后面有一个光幕，光幕把三层大部分空间都罩在里面。
里面有数十具傀儡存在，人类、动物形态都有。
柳辰现在二层通往三层的入口处，一脸的激动，因为只要解决掉上面两只傀儡他的傀儡就有着落了。
数十具傀儡，总有适合自己的一款，哪怕其中最弱的对自己来说也够用了。
“不过好像那两具傀儡不怎么好对付啊”
柳辰抬头看去，三层的方向不时有火焰溢出，轰轰声以及金属交鸣声响个不停。
content_en:
Liu Chen looked at the entrance to the third floor with some hope. It was no wonder that Liu Chen looked like this. The first two floors were really disappointing.
Liu Chen was originally a little nervous before entering the tower, worried about encountering new dangers.
The result was far beyond his expectation. Not only did the door into the tower have no restrictions, it opened easily.
The first two floors are a little too ordinary. There is nothing on the first floor except a few stone statues made of the same material as the tower body.
On the second floor, there are only some ordinary tables, chairs and tea sets, but the wood made of them is a rare and precious species.
If he hadn't found two puppets in the corner of the second floor, Liu Chen would have thought that this was the living room of some secular nobleman, rather than the residence of a powerful monk.
These two puppets were finally put into Mu Yurou's space equipment.
In her words, these are two life-assisted puppets that are responsible for some of the trivial tasks in the monk's daily life, such as cleaning.
Such puppets generally do not have attack capabilities, but they are all in human form. After all, monks are different from warriors. They have huge families in the secular world and are driven by a large number of maids and slaves.
Most of the monks are ascetic monks, and most of them live alone. At this time, this type of puppet is needed to help solve some trivial matters in life.
Both of these puppets were in female form, and Mu Yurou planned to take them back for her own use.
However, Mu Yurou promised that if he met a combat-type puppet suitable for him later, she would give him one and help him refine a jade token that he could control.
Because the soul of a warrior is relatively weak, he does not have spiritual consciousness before he breaks through to become a formal warrior.
Therefore, if Liu Chen wants to control the puppet, he needs the assistance of special magic weapons.
This is why Liu Chen is looking forward to the future. If he can get a powerful puppet, it will greatly improve his strength.
And Liu Chen has a high chance of getting it, because Mu Yurou said that apart from weapon refining, what Old Man Wuchang is best at is puppetry.
"touch, touch"
As soon as the two entered the third floor, Mu Yurou, who was walking in front, was attacked twice.
Fortunately, Mu Yurou reacted quickly enough and used a shield in time to block the two attacks.
"These are two first-level combat puppets. We can't move forward until we deal with them. You go back to the second floor first, and you can come up again after I deal with them."
Mu Yurou, who blocked the attack, turned to Liu Chen and said.
Liu Chen didn't dare to stay when he heard this, and hurriedly retreated along the stairs.
But before leaving, he still glanced in the direction of the third floor.
At this glance, Liu Chen was immediately shocked. He saw that the space on the third floor was much larger than Liu Chen imagined.
Liu Chen saw a snake and a saber-toothed tiger guarding there. Their whole bodies were made of unknown metal. They were obviously not real living organisms.
At this time, there were lights flickering in the mouths of the two puppets, which was obviously the attack just now.
They should be the two first-level puppets that Mu Yurou mentioned. These two puppets are several meters in size, giving Liu Chen a strong sense of oppression.
This was not what shocked Liu Chen the most. What shocked him the most was that there was a light curtain behind the two puppets. The light curtain covered most of the space on the third floor.
There are dozens of puppets inside, both in human and animal forms.
Liu Chen was now at the entrance from the second floor to the third floor, with a look of excitement on his face, because as long as he eliminated the two puppets above, he would have his puppet.
There are dozens of puppets, there is always one that suits you, even the weakest among them is enough for you.
"But it seems that those two puppets are not easy to deal with."
Liu Chen looked up and saw flames spilling out from time to time in the direction of the third floor, and there were constant roars and metal sounds.
